verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs describe install options (encryption, dual-boot 'Quattro') and interface conventions (all-keyboard operation, menu structure, themes) which could help a newcomer, and some community reports call the install 'uncomplicated' and a great out-of-the-box experience. However there is no evidence of structured guided tutorials for switchers, and other community feedback notes rough edges (boot splash, single-user setup quirks, unclear docs about default browser) suggesting the onboarding is not a polished guided walkthrough.
